source: docs/index.html, the published report (captured headless with Edge at 1600x900, deviceScaleFactor 1.5)
notes: Full-page shots are 2400x1350; *_pN.png are the same step scrolled down; crops (finding cards, tables, plots, tooltips) have their own size.
Captions quote numbers read from <Model>/report/model.json and model_v0.1.json.

bumper_v0_02_geometry_thickness_sheets.png is the only shot where the page state was altered in memory: spot-weld spring pseudo-parts were excluded from the thickness colour scale. The report file itself was never modified.
The phone offers no plastic-strain colouring in either version (peak_plastic_strain is empty for every phone part in model_v0.1.json), so no phone strain shot exists.
